searchResults.highlight: Insider is a company that operates in the marketing technology sector. Its offerings include a customer data platform, personalization, journey orchestration, and behavioral analytics, aimed at improving customer interactions across various channels. Insider serves sectors including retail, financial services, travel, beauty, automotive, and telecommunications. It was founded in 2012 and is based in Istanbul, Turkey.
